news.headline: Can the 0-3 Texans defy history again to make playoffs?
news.detail: Houston became the first team in the common playoff format to make the postseason after starting 0-3 in 2025.

news.headline: Houston's offense struggled for a second consecutive week in the absence of top wide receiver Nico Collins (hamstring).
news.detail: Houston's offense struggled for a second consecutive week in the absence of top wide receiver Nico Collins (hamstring). Stroud threw a one-yard touchdown pass to Foster Moreau in the second quarter, but the Texans dropped to 0-3 for the second consecutive season. Houston bounced back to finish 12-5
